newsitem.title: USA: OPTIONS - US bond vols claw back above 9.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS - US bond vols claw back above 9.0 percent.

text.p: Implied volatilities for at-the-money options on U.S. Treasury bond futures climbed above 9.0 percent Wednesday for the first time in several weeks, but analysts were loathe to declare an uptrend.
Rather, traders and analysts stressed bond vols were just returning to typical levels after several weeks of unusally low readings.
"Everybody has been talking about how cheap it is for so long that it has finally started to climb back to normal," said one options trader for a U.S. banking firm.
